_help: Main switch: set "mode" to "demo" (sample data, no internet needed) or "live" (real RSS feeds and job boards). Everything else has safe defaults.
_contactEmail: A mailbox publishers can use to reach you about the bot. Use a role address such as news@funds.ae, not a personal one. It is added to the user-agent; the SEC asks for one and may block requests without it. The FUNDSAE_CONTACT_EMAIL environment variable overrides it.
_publicBaseUrl: The site's public address with a trailing slash (e.g. https://funds.ae/), used for canonical links on story pages. Leave empty to omit them. FUNDSAE_PUBLIC_BASE_URL overrides it.

publish._help: maxArchive: stories in news/real-estate.json (the Real Estate Capital News page). maxDropPercent: news:publish refuses to write when the number of live stories would fall by more than this (a safety stop for a wrong dataset or token).

review._help: The news review queue: nothing ingested reaches the site until an approver publishes it (docs/NEWS-REVIEW-GUIDE.md). store: "file" keeps the queue in backend/data (demo mode and tests), "sanity" keeps it in the Sanity Studio (live). approverIds: Sanity user ids allowed to approve and publish; must equal NEWS_APPROVER_IDS in studio/schemaTypes/newsRules.js; empty = nobody can publish. Unreviewed stories are deleted pendingTtlDays after they were last seen in a feed, rejected ones rejectedTtlDays after rejection; approved, published and archived stories are kept. documentBudget protects the Sanity Free plan's 10,000-document limit: a warning at warnAt, no new stories at stopCreatesAt.

ai._help: Optional AI suggestions for new stories: a short summary written from the headline and the publisher's excerpt only, plus Capital Type, Asset Class, geography and transaction suggestions. Off by default. Needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (a GitHub secret for the News ingest workflow) and runs only for sources with allowAiSummary: true, because many publishers' terms forbid AI summaries. Every suggestion still needs an editor's approval. model and effort are Claude settings; maxPerRun caps the stories enriched per run (cost control).

registry._help: Where sources.news.json and news-taxonomy.json (Capital Types, Asset Classes) come from. "file": edit them by hand. "sanity": the Studio is the source and `npm run cms:pull` overwrites them. Switch only after importing them into Sanity (docs/NEWS-REVIEW-GUIDE.md).

content._help: Where sponsors.json, events.json and content.json come from. "file": edit them by hand. "sanity": the Sanity Studio is the source and `npm run cms:pull` (run by the Publish content workflow) overwrites them. Switch only after importing the current content into Sanity: see docs/SANITY-CMS-GUIDE.md.

employers._help: Top Employers on the Careers page (column 2) are derived from open roles. The list shows 20.

events._help: Events come from config/events.json. Upcoming events are published, plus anything that ended in the last keepPastDays.

submissions._help: Website forms (contact, newsletter, advertise, event, job). Only used by the optional server; GitHub Pages cannot receive forms. Stored in backend/data/submissions/ (git-ignored) and deleted after retentionDays by `npm run submissions:prune`.
